from pydantic import BaseModel

class Person(BaseModel):
    name: str
    age: int
    email: str | None = None

# Produce JSON schema as dict
schema = Person.model_json_schema()
print("JSON Schema:")

print()

print()

json_string_pretty = person.model_dump_json(indent=2)
